content_html:
watched #PrathiRojuPandage : Story wise it appeared to be sequel to #SathamanamBhavati….and also 80% of the taking resembels the same. However the director Maruthi tried to add his trade mark humour along with making Heorines char to potray that of a Tick Tok addict, Apart from that this movie has nothing different to many of the recently released so called Family Value Movies!!!

Rao Ramesh is the solo pillar of this otherwise routine family drama and carried it on hus shoulders….after couple of scenes we will start believing that he and only he is the Hero Villan and Comedian of the movie!!! Rashi Khana did a good performance as Tick Tok queen and all the remaining family members did good role to complement Rao Ramesh’s terrific performance!!!! Sai Dharam Tej literally had an extended cameo kind of role and he did a decent job…..

nothing much to say about other departments as they neither did a worst job nor did a great job!!!!
